cases.label: Monaco style proxy

spec.rationale: High downforce style proxy with strong camber for slow corner study.

cases.sparkPrompt: High downforce style proxy, strong camber, alpha near 10, Re near 200k.

engineer.headline: Camber carries the slow corner
engineer.explanation: What changed: alpha held at 10. Why: camber adds circulation at low speed. What to try next: thin the section for the straight.

cases.label: Monza style proxy

spec.rationale: Low drag style proxy with a thin section for straight line study.

cases.sparkPrompt: Low drag style proxy, thin section, alpha near 3, Re near 500k.

engineer.headline: Thin section keeps drag low
engineer.explanation: What changed: alpha held at 3. Why: thin section trims pressure drag. What to try next: add a touch of camber for the corner.
engineer.caveats: 2D potential flow only, not wind tunnel data.
